description: Defines ASN.1 related structures and classes for 3GPP RRC NR protocol messages, specifically for paging information and UE identity.

classes.name: group_paging_r18_s
classes.description: Represents a group paging structure for R18, including reception permission.

classes.name: paging_ue_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice of UE identity types, such as NG-5G-S-TMSI or Full I-RNTI.

classes.name: paging_record_s
classes.description: Represents a paging record containing UE ID and related info.

classes.name: paging_record_v1800_s
classes.description: Paging record structure for version 1800, including MT SDT presence.

classes.name: paging_v1800_ies_s
classes.description: Paging information element for version 1800, including record and group lists.

classes.name: paging_v1700_ies_s
classes.description: Paging information element for version 1700, including record and group lists.

classes.name: paging_s
classes.description: Main paging sequence structure including records, extensions, and non-critical extensions.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of the choice type in paging_ue_id_c.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Destroys the choice buffer in paging_ue_id_c.
